machine_layout.presentation: Three angled feeds, round central mixer with walkaround path, carried numeric output, and three compact bottom checks.

supplied_boundary: Supplied engine handles angled feeds, movement, circular mixer collision, directional projectile throws, numeric output snapshots, and three check destinations. Arithmetic only changes the central mixer through exact learner results. Copying a number preserves the mixer. Each order has a fixed left target and delivered right operand. Learner Boolean controls YES/NO; a nonmutating observer may reject inconsistent YES but never repair it. Targets stay fixed during a round.
starter_policy: A comment-only template resource and starter main.ts use // Cake Factory while supplying no executable learner code, variables or solution events.
hint_policy: Fourteen constructions have current native Blocks hints. Pages15-17 reuse code for gameplay practice.
comparison_policy: Five comparisons ==, <, >, <=, >= return Boolean; no compound logical operators.
claim_boundary: Declared implementation ownership and intended behavior; runtime and presentation checks remain separate.
modifier_representation: Planned 112x24 single-line SET card with mixer icon and numeric operand; copied numbers are 34x28 in a native640x480 room.
interaction_presentation: Four side variables, explicit B check animation, and charged A release throw arcs.

progression.startup: Empty static belts, hidden output and orders.
progression.output: Learner initializes batch and reveals its dispenser value.
progression.belts: Student Boolean starts center; left unlocks at10 and right at13.
progression.orders: One center order until SetBatch; all3 then ingredient variables in next round.
progression.controls: Arrows move; A picks up; next A throws; delivery automatically checks.
